blocks.prompt: 4. Find the general solution of the differential equation \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \sqrt{y}\cos^2\sqrt{y}\).
blocks.explanation:
Right side \(\sqrt{y}\cos^2\sqrt{y}\) mein sirf \(y\) hai, \(x\) bilkul nahi; yani \(g(x) = 1\).
Is liye equation separable hai.
Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Plan: alag karenge, \(\frac{1}{\cos^2}\) ko \(\sec^2\) likhenge, aur integral ke liye \(u = \sqrt{y}\) substitution lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \sqrt{y}\cos^2\sqrt{y}\), \(y > 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Equation separable hai kyunke right side sirf \(y\) ka function hai. Alag karne ke baad \(y\) wala integral thora mushkil lagta hai, is liye \(u = \sqrt{y}\) rakh kar usay aasaan banayenge.

Variables alag karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{\sqrt{y}\cos^2\sqrt{y}} = dx\]
\[\dfrac{\sec^2\sqrt{y}}{\sqrt{y}}\,dy = dx\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(\sqrt{y}\cos^2\sqrt{y}\) se divide kiya aur \(dx\) se multiply kiya. Phir \(\frac{1}{\cos^2\theta} = \sec^2\theta\) likha, kyunke \(\sec^2\) ka integral humein yaad hai (\(\tan\)).

\(u = \sqrt{y}\) rakhein
\[du = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{y}}\,dy\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{\sqrt{y}} = 2\,du\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{y}\) ki derivative \(\frac{1}{2\sqrt{y}}\) hai. Integral mein \(\frac{dy}{\sqrt{y}}\) pehle se mojood hai, bas 2 ka farq hai. Jab andar wale function ki derivative bahar mojood ho to substitution sab se acha tareeqa hai.

Dono taraf integrate karein
\[\int 2\sec^2u\,du = \int dx\]
\[2\tan u = x + C\]
\[2\tan\sqrt{y} = x + C\]
Kyun: \(\tan u\) ki derivative \(\sec^2u\) hai, is liye \(\int\sec^2u\,du = \tan u\). Aakhir mein \(u = \sqrt{y}\) wapas rakha.
Dhyan dein: 2 ka factor bhoolna aam ghalti hai; woh \(dy = 2\sqrt{y}\,du\) se aaya hai.

Tasdeeq
\(2\tan\sqrt{y} = x + C\) ko differentiate karein:
\[2\sec^2\sqrt{y} \cdot \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{y}}\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 1\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \sqrt{y}\cos^2\sqrt{y}\]
Kyun: Chain rule do dafa laga: \(\tan\) ki derivative \(\sec^2\), phir \(\sqrt{y}\) ki derivative. 2 cancel ho gaya aur \(\sec^2\) ulta ho kar \(\cos^2\) ban gaya. Di hui equation mil gayi.
